description: If a letter from the Lieutenant Governor’s office showed up in your mailbox, you probably had questions. I voted for SB 153. Here’s the full story, including what the bill actually does, who keeps their privacy protection, and what to do before the May 6 deadline if you qualify.

title: About That Letter You May Have Received About SB 153 | The 52 Report
